# scm_ztna_connector_quiesce (Data Source)

Get Connector Quiesce State

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Retrieve the quiesce state of a ZTNA Connector.
data "scm_ztna_connector_quiesce" "example" {
  oid = "22222222-2222-2222-2222-222222222222"
}

output "connector_quiesce" {
  value = {
    mode = data.scm_ztna_connector_quiesce.example.mode
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `oid` (String) Parent connector OID.

### Read-Only

- `mode` (String)
- `tfid` (String)
